description: A7 ground truth: hand-parsed requirement details from the 12 richest requirements documents in the archive (see requirements_catalog.json for the full sweep). Each record is what a correct A7 extraction pass SHOULD produce for that document. Parsed manually from extracted PDF text on 2026-07-02 — no LLM involved. Dollar amounts are as written in the source document.
schema_note: required_coverages[].limits keys mirror ACORD 25 limit boxes where possible so they can be compared 1:1 against registry template policies[].limits. 'conditional' marks coverages only required in certain situations (contract size, work type).
